As per paragraph 2 of the petition, the petitioner declares that he was working as Editor (Chandigarh) of "The Indian Express" (Chandigarh Edition), printed and published by The Indian Express Private Limited, and at that time, the petitioner was a resident of Chandigarh and now, a resident of Panchkula. 3.
